name: tc-winguard
goal: The Crew, Phase 0 (2026-10-23): the Windows command guard's rule core, winguard.rs, for a Claude Code PreToolUse hook on the PowerShell tool. Kris: rewrite when the translation is certain, block ambiguous Linux commands with the PowerShell form, log every hit. Scope M (byte-exact notes, quote-aware splitting). 2026-10-23 13:05: Qwen's first two replies died at the provider's 10-minute gateway limit (HTTP 5xx after ~611 s each); per Kris's rule (reassign when an endpoint keeps failing) Gordon authors and Hoss tests, on the new rework/relay campaign code.

tasks.instructions: Byte-exact: copy every note template and every suggestion string character for character. split works on chars with an explicit state (OUTSIDE/SINGLE/DOUBLE/HERE-SINGLE/HERE-DOUBLE). check runs the WHOLE block pass over every segment before any rewrite. Walk every row of the worked-example tables through your code. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
tasks.test_instructions: One test per rule, comparing whole Verdict values with assert_eq!. Include: a block winning over a rewrite in another segment, a here-string containing a separator, a piped where, the several-paths rule with a 2>/dev/null word that must not count as an argument, and split round-tripping (joined pieces equal the input).
